lines.en: Head low, horns forward.
Four short legs press the pine needles.
My frill blocks the wind for me.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，树枝都折了。
lines.en: Branches snap where I pass.

lines.zh: 我沿着针叶林边慢慢走。
lines.en: I move slowly along the conifer edge.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴摆着，很有分量。
lines.en: My tail swings with weight.
I smell pine resin.
I go around a stand of low trees.
I stop and lift my horns.
A few of my kind are with me.
I come down the slope steadily.
I raise my head at the trees.
Standing, frill to the wind.
I crop the low leaves.
Old marks on my horns.
The needles are tough; I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 身边有一头小的跟着我。
lines.en: A small one follows me.
Wind whistles over my frill.
I listen to the wood.
My toes grip the needles.
I shake my neck.
Resin sticks to my horns.
Three horns, all sound.
No strangers in this wood.

lines.zh: 我的影子把一片草压暗了。
lines.en: My shadow darkens a patch of grass.
You stand in front of my horns.
I do not like people coming near.
This body is not easily pushed.
Stand aside a little.

lines.zh: 我见过你这种两脚的东西。
lines.en: I have seen your kind before.
My frill is not for show.
When I lower my head, I am ready to charge.
You have rope in your hand.
Nothing stops my charge, not even trees.

lines.zh: 你的靴子会被松针滑倒。
lines.en: The needles will slip your boots.
A scratch across my frill.

lines.zh: 蹄子在松针上滑了寸许。
lines.en: My hoof slid an inch on the needles.

lines.zh: 盾角挨了一下，我顶回去。
lines.en: A blow hits my frill; I push back.
Blood runs along a plate.
A dull ache in a horn.
I laboriously square my body.
I can still charge.
You have made me angry.
That clump of leaves looks good.
Leave it on the needles.
I eat only the low leaves.
Back off first, then I eat.
These are still not enough.
The grass here is tough.
I smell something sweet.
A little nearer.
I can bite through this.

lines.zh: 三只角抵地，谁都别想推我。
lines.en: Three horns to the ground—no one shoves me.
All four hooves are dug in.
Back off. My horns will catch you.
Shove my shoulder and I stay put.
Let neither of us push harder.
I turn my head to one side.
You kicked needles into my face.
Do not walk pressed against me.
I already have a mate in the group.
The frill must be fully grown.
No time for that this season.
Bark matters more than this.
You carry no weight here.
First let us see that the wood is safe.
Give me some room.
I am not inclined yet.
I am off into the woods.
A pine cone lies on the ground.
I bite this branch through and drag it off.
Two bites and I give up.
I nudge it to one side.
A pine cone can be chewed too.
My mouth cannot reach.
This is not edible at all.
I should keep this.
That pine cone is mine.
You have come very close.
I drop my frill low.
My horns are aimed.
You are on my ground.
These trees will not stop me.
I am charging now.
Get to open ground.
The young one is behind me.
I toss my head up.
Take it.
I plant my feet.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，松针都在抖。
lines.en: My breathing is heavy; the pine needles shake.
The needles rustle underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很沉，三只角对着你。
lines.en: My breath is heavy; three horns face you.
I look for a clean angle.

lines.zh: 三根角压低，我准备冲了。
lines.en: Three horns lowered; I am ready to charge.
You are edging right.
Stone has time to spare.
The roots will trip you.
Hold one more beat.
I am about to move.
This is the moment.
Do not turn your head.
My horn tips strike you.
I drive my whole head at you.
My frill drives you back.
You are lifted and dropped.
That landed with a heavy thud.
I kick up a spray of needles.
My horn lodges in a tree.
I pull free and thrust again.
You went back four paces.
That tore the soil open.
The ground you stood on is bare.
The young one has drawn back.
You are thrown against a root.
I cannot pull this one.
I come out of the pines.
The grass is still pressed where I passed.
I sweep the pine wood with my eyes.
Three of my kind are nearby.
Resin on my frill.
I plant all four feet.
A sound deep in the pines.
I move with heavy care.
Tree shadow falls on my back.
Wind passes through the needles.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身体，针叶从背上落下。
lines.en: I shake and pine needles fall off my back.
Prints in the pine needles.

lines.zh: 针叶林里传来沉重的脚步。
lines.en: Heavy steps sound through the taiga.
I have come to a stop.
Fire licks across my frill.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，撞断一棵树。
lines.en: I roll down and break a tree.
Water to my chest.
The blast throws the needles up.
An arrow wedges at the base of my horn.
This light blinds me.
There are not enough leaves here.

lines.zh: 雷劈在角上，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn and I jolt.
No pines below.
